blocks.title: 📰 7. 🏆 AWARDS, BOOKS, INDICES & RANKINGS
blocks.text: 🪝 DPIIT Revises Index of Core Industries (ICI) Base Year to 2022-23 & Adds 'Iron Ore' as 9th Core Industry. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Increases core industries count from 8 to 9; combined IIP (index of industrial production measuring physical output) weightage set at 32.88%.

Base Year Revision: Base year updated to 2022-23 (replacing 2011-12 base) to align with GDP, WPI (wholesale price index tracking producer inflation), and IIP (index of industrial production measuring physical output).
9th Core Industry: 'Iron Ore' added as 9th core industry (Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilisers, Steel, Cement, Electricity, Iron Ore).

IIP (index of industrial production measuring physical output) Weightage: Combined weight of 9 core industries in IIP (index of industrial production measuring physical output) stands at 32.88% (down from 40.27%).
New base year (2022-23) vs combined core industries weightage in IIP (32.88%).
